units.source_text: 腊尽春回，源氏看到烂漫春光，心情越发郁结，悲伤依旧不改。

en.t: As winter ended and spring returned, Genji saw the radiant spring scenery, yet his heart grew still more troubled, and his sorrow remained unchanged.

units.source_text: 外面照例有许多人前来贺岁。

en.t: Outside, as usual, many people came to offer New Year greetings.

units.source_text: 但源氏以心绪不佳为由，只管闭居在帘内。

en.t: But Genji, saying that he was in poor spirits, simply stayed shut away behind the curtains.

units.source_text: 惟有萤兵部卿亲王来时，请他到内室畅叙，命侍者传诗云：

en.t: Only when Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War, came did he invite him into the inner room for a long talk and order an attendant to convey this poem:
